_variant_split.principle: The hard technical paths run on UK, the default, so a failure is unambiguously a pipeline defect rather than a variant defect. US goes to terminologically rich but technically straightforward documents, so variant divergence is what gets tested.

_conclusions_replicated_across_documents: Script time is 0-1%; model time 99-100%. Twelve runs from twelve. No efficiency work should touch the Python.
Runtime is 24.6 + 0.040 x paragraphs minutes -- about 25 minutes of fixed overhead and 2.4 seconds a paragraph. The skill has one gear, and that is the runtime problem.
The 35-paragraph batch cap is an ATTENTION cap, not a context cap. Context was never the binding constraint on any run.
Context is not a constraint: the skill-side peak is 6.4% of the 1M window. The live reasons to care about file size are findability and truncation, not tokens.
Quality and terminology scored 9 on all twelve; English-variant conformance scored 10 on all twelve. Translation quality is not the problem.
Batch position degrades the POLICING, not the translation. The controlled pair scored 9/9/9 on the translation criteria in both runs.
_two_gaps_the_corpus_cannot_reach: No Symbol or Wingdings runs anywhere, so the Greek-glyph defect cannot be reproduced from a real document.
Content controls, smart tags, images with alt text and charts with titles appear in none of the eleven.
